title: TextEDA IR v0.8 — manifest shard
description: Shard manifest and hashes: one sha256 per shard (computed over the canonical JSON bytes) and its classification; the project hash covers the normative shards, the advisory hash the advisory ones (ADR-0023 decision 4, amended 2026-10-22). The hashes are recomputed by rule and not persisted elsewhere. See ADR-0008 decision 5.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that produced the IR; the other half of artifact traceability.

shards.description: Shard list: path, content hash and classification of each shard. The classification decides which hash the shard enters (ADR-0023 decision 4).

path.description: Shard path relative to dist/ir/, e.g. boards/charger-buck/schematic.json.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of this shard's canonical JSON bytes.

normative.description: Whether the build depends on this shard. A normative shard is part of the build identity; an advisory one is not (ADR-0023 decision 4, amended 2026-10-22). The classification is a property of the source file, so a tool never has to infer it from a path.

source_hash.description: Project hash = SHA-256(concatenation of "<path>:<sha256>\n" lines after sorting the normative shards by path). The board hash uses the same rule over the subset of that board's normative shards.

advisory_hash.description: Advisory hash = SHA-256(concatenation of "<path>:<sha256>\n" lines after sorting the advisory shards by path). Absent when the project has no advisory shard. A hash identifies a build, not the project's file set: changing an advisory shard changes this hash and leaves the project hash alone.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.
